test_credit.source: server new-user quota, auto-granted on register (verified configured on lianhua site)

notes: base_url = management host (register/login/balance); model_base_url = inference host, kept with /v1 so internal /chat/completions verification resolves correctly
new-user quota is auto-granted by site admin; user API cannot issue credit; redeem code path kept as fallback only
model/display_name are lowercase to match the live model ID verified on the lianhua site; uppercase Kimi-K3.1-Pro does not resolve
workbuddy base_url intentionally has NO /v1: this is the exact value already working in the user's models.json; WorkBuddy appends the completion path itself

capability flags and reasoning.supportedEfforts mirror the user's verified working entry; max_input_tokens/max_output_tokens are intentionally null so the written entry has NO token-cap fields, exactly matching the user's working config (WorkBuddy then uses the model's native 1M context)
new-user credit is auto-granted; redeem flow is fallback only
model-driven scheduled task may not start when quota is exhausted; recharge URL is the manual fallback
